subject: mathematics_2a
question_text: For a binomial distribution with mean 6 and variance 2, find the first two terms of the distribution.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the first two terms of this binomial distribution — how you get n, p and q, and what r values the first two terms use.
insider_note: The first two terms are P(X = 0) and P(X = 1), not P(X = 1) and P(X = 2); in P(X = 1) = 9·(1/3)⁸·(2/3) the 9 cancels against 3², so the answer reduces to 2/3⁷.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Find n, p, q
steps.margin_note: First mark. q = variance/mean = 2/6 = 1/3, p = 2/3, n = 6/p = 9. The 'first two terms' are P(X = 0) and P(X = 1), so n, p and q must be found before either can be written.

recall.must_convey: That np = 6 and npq = 2 give q = 1/3, p = 2/3 and n = 9.
accept: mean n p is six and variance n p q is two so q is one by three p is two by three and n is nine
divide variance by mean to get q a third, then p two thirds and n nine
q one third, p two thirds, n nine
npq by np cheste q one by three, p two by three, n nine
n is nine with p two thirds

steps.why: The two given numbers are two equations in n and p. Dividing removes n and gives q; then p follows, and n comes from the mean.
common_mistakes: Writing n = 6 × 3/2 = 9 with no line showing np = 6.
Using q = 2/3 and p = 1/3 in the terms.

steps.label: Write P(X = 0) and P(X = 1)
steps.margin_note: Second mark. P(X = 0) = ⁹C₀ q⁹ = (1/3)⁹ = 1/3⁹. P(X = 1) = ⁹C₁ q⁸ p = 9 · (1/3)⁸ · (2/3) = 18/3⁹ = 2/3⁷. Cancel the 9 against 3² — that is why the power drops from 9 to 7.
lines: P(X = r) = ⁿCᵣ qⁿ⁻ʳ pʳ = ⁹Cᵣ (1/3)⁹⁻ʳ (2/3)ʳ

accept: P of zero is one by three to the nine and P of one is nine into one by three to the eight into two by three which is two by three to the seven
the first term is q to the nine and the second is nine q to the eight p
one over three to the ninth and two over three to the seventh
P zero one by three power nine, P one nine into one by three power eight into two by three, two by three power seven
the first two terms are one by three to the nine and two by three to the seven
heard_as: one by three to the nine
two by three to the seven

steps.why: The terms of a binomial distribution are P(X = 0), P(X = 1), … in order, so the first two are r = 0 and r = 1. The 9 from ⁹C₁ cancels two factors of 3, which is the only simplification.
common_mistakes: Taking the first two terms as P(X = 1) and P(X = 2).
